high_level_description: This image depicts a classroom scene with students engaged in learning. The setting appears to be a modestly furnished room with wooden beams on the ceiling and light green walls. There is a whiteboard mounted on the wall above a wooden shelf that holds various items such as papers and a metallic object. The students are seated at wooden desks arranged in rows, facing the front of the classroom where the whiteboard is located. They are wearing casual clothing, including caps and plaid shirts, suggesting a relaxed or informal educational environment.
